subject: Request: one-off extended POC + extra credits for MedPath Labs (regulated prospect)
content:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-off extended POC + extra credits for MedPath Labs (regulated prospect)

Team —

Quick ask: MedPath Labs (regulated diagnostics provider) is stuck in procurement for a HIPAA review; their engineering team needs a longer sandbox and additional free credits to complete an end-to-end validation that includes PHI-scrubbed workloads. Without this extension they can’t finish the integration that drives their expected production date.

Snapshot:
- Account: MedPath Labs (Anjali Kapoor, Jonathan Price)
- Current PLG sandbox: 30 days, $5k free credits (standard)
- Requested: extend sandbox to 60 days + one-off $20,000 free credits (beyond PLG limits)
- Rationale: regulated workloads require additional evaluation time; procurement has confirmed NDA and needs time for security questionnaire review. Engineering demo scheduled for 9/15.
- Commercial signal: primary use-case maps to our Dedicated offering; forecasted ARR if successful ~ $180k; conversion probability (sales estimate) 50%.

Attachments: MedPath_MAP_v2.pdf (mutual action plan), MedPath_HIPAA_Checklist.xlsx (completed SOC/HIPAA notes). HubSpot link in related links.

Ask: Seeking CXO-level one-off approval to grant the $20k POC credit and extend sandbox to 60 days. Prefer approval that includes the following conditions: PO or signed purchase intent within 45 days of credit issuance; credits applied as a pre-paid invoice credit to first invoice(s); we retain the right to clawback unused credits if no PO within 75 days.

Why this matters: MedPath is a regulated vertical logo with reference potential in healthcare; the extended evaluation materially increases likelihood of conversion. If approved, I’ll coordinate legal for a short addendum and Ops for tagging usage limits.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off extended POC + extra credits for MedPath Labs (regulated prospect)

Mina —

Thanks for the clear summary. A couple of clarifying asks before I sign off:
1) Can you confirm the conversion trigger(s) — i.e., what event do we consider the qualified conversion that will move them to paid Dedicated? (example: completed integration + PO)
2) What specific data residency / HIPAA artifacts do they require that push this beyond the normal sandbox? Is this purely time or technical capability?
3) Can we tier the credit release (e.g., $15k now, $5k after milestone) to reduce downside?

If the answers look solid I'd be comfortable with a one-off credit approval conditional on finance/legal sign-off and a PO timeline.

Jonas
CEO, Redwood Inference

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off extended POC + extra credits for MedPath Labs (regulated prospect)

Jonas/Rishi —

Answers below:
1) Conversion trigger: Signed PO for Dedicated or a contract addendum to Hosted+Dedicated pilot within 60 days after completion of the extended eval AND successful completion of the integration checklist in the MAP (attachment). We will mark the MAP milestones in HubSpot and require the customer to sign off on the final acceptance test.
2) HIPAA artifacts: they need a run-through with our SOC2 + data flow diagrams, and they want to exercise our PHI-scrubbing pipeline on a representative (de-identified) dataset. This is time-consuming and requires multiple iterations with their security team — primary driver is time, not new capability.
3) Tiered release: I can do $12.5k now and $7.5k upon MAP milestone sign-off, but they pushed back and said the integration team needs the full runway to complete load testing. Their procurement lead indicated a PO will be ready within 2–4 weeks after legal/controls review.

Given the account economics and reference upside in healthcare, I recommend approving the full $20k with the PO-in-45-days clause and clawback at 75 days if no commitment.

HubSpot deal and MAP draft are linked in related_links.

Thanks —
Mina

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off extended POC + extra credits for MedPath Labs (regulated prospect)

Mina —

I reviewed the MAP, HubSpot signals, and the financial case. Approve one-off concession under the following conditions:
- Approved amount: $20,000 POC credit (one-time).
- Sandbox extension: 60 days from issuance date.
- Terms: Credits are issued as a contra invoice credit to be applied against the first invoice(s) after conversion.
- Required documentation: PO or signed purchase intent within 45 days of credit issuance; if no PO, finance will attempt to recoup unused credits up to 75 days.
- Legal: legal to review a brief addendum (I’ll route to Legal and copy you).
- Expiry of approval: 30 days from this email — if not consumed, approval lapses and requires re-approval.

I’ll generate an approval stub and route to Finance/Legal. Deal ID: DL-2026-0491.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: approval_stub.pdf

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Anjali Kapoor <anjali@medpathlabs.com>, Jonathan Price <jonathan.price@medpathlabs.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — Extended sandbox + POC credits approved for MedPath Labs

Hi Anjali / Jonathan —

Good news: Internal approval is in place to extend your sandbox to 60 days and provide a one-time $20,000 evaluation credit to complete the integration tests outlined in the MAP. Conditions: we need a PO or signed purchase intent within 45 days of credit issuance; credits will be reflected as a pre-paid credit against your first invoice(s). Legal will send a short addendum to confirm the credit mechanics and clawback language.

Next steps:
- You: expect legal addendum and Ops onboarding notes within 48 hours.
- You: try to route a PO through procurement within 45 days (contacts included).
- We: will enable the additional credit and extend sandbox once we receive a quick confirmation from your procurement lead.

Thanks for the partnership — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

From: Anjali Kapoor <anjali@medpathlabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonathan Price <jonathan.price@medpathlabs.com>, Procurement <procurement@medpathlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — Extended sandbox + POC credits approved for MedPath Labs

Mina —

Fantastic news, thank you. We appreciate the flexibility — this makes the difference for our security team to complete testing. Procurement will prioritize the PO; we expect to share a PO within 10–14 business days. Jonathan and I will review the addendum when legal sends it.

Appreciate the quick action,
Anjali Kapoor
Director of Engineering, MedPath Labs
